account-id.description: Provider-assigned account, subscription, project, or tenant identifier; preserve its string form, including leading zeroes.

account-type.description: Source account type, such as AWS Account, Azure Subscription, GCP Project, or M365 Tenant.

disabled.description: Whether the account is disabled, when explicitly reported.

locked.description: Whether the account is locked, when explicitly reported.

on-premises-sync-enabled.description: Whether an on-premises directory synchronizes this account.

organization-id.description: Identifier of the organization containing this account.

partition.description: Provider partition or isolated cloud environment.

project-id.description: Project identifier when recorded separately from the account identifier.

provider.description: Cloud or SaaS provider that defines the account identifier's scope.

region.description: Cloud region associated with the observation.

zone.description: Availability zone associated with the observation.

description: A cloud or SaaS account, subscription, project, or tenant, with provider and organizational scope. Use user-account for individual security principals. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/account, https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/cloud.
name: cloud-account
